1. ambil kontrak DATA Wa failed jika sms project sudah terflag Y semua,seblum dijalanin querynya koordinais sama denny dulu ya

-- Ambil data failed NON DC dan SMS Project
SELECT DISTINCT wa_data.param1
FROM wa_data
LEFT JOIN wa_bulk_dr
ON wa_data.wa_id = wa_bulk_dr.messageid
WHERE DATE(wa_data.created_timestamp) = CURDATE() 
AND wa_data.template_name in('script_wa_project')
AND (
(wa_data.source_sms = 'SMS PROJECT'
AND TIME(wa_data.created_timestamp) >= '18:00:00'
)
OR
(wa_data.source_sms = 'SMS NON DC'
AND TIME(wa_data.created_timestamp) >= '08:00:00'
))
AND (
wa_bulk_dr.status = 'failed' OR wa_data.delivery_status = 'failed'
);

4. Pastikan jgn slah hapus,yang kontrak meta failed yg gak dihapus

5. kirim sms seperti bisa yg sering dijalanin sms project pag

6. generate result sampe INSERT result
   http://172.16.30.33:3108/c_ws_sms
  
7. generate result  wa project ke stg_coll_result_sms
   http://172.16.30.33:3108/c_ws_whatsapp

INSERT INTO db_sim.STG_COLLECTION_RESULT_SMS_TASK (
  stg_no_lkp_sms,
  stg_seqno,
  contract_no,
  flag,
  result,
  created_timestamp
)
SELECT
  a.stg_no_lkp_sms,
  a.stg_seqno,
  a.CONTRACT_NO,
  'N',
  c.result,
  NOW()
FROM 
  STG_COLLECTION_SMS_TASK a
JOIN
  STG_COLLECTION_RESULT_SMS_TASK_april_2026 c
ON 
   a.contract_no = c.contract_no
AND 
   c.created_timestamp BETWEEN '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-09-01 23:59:59'
AND 
   a.contract_no NOT IN (SELECT CONTRACT_NO FROM STG_COLLECTION_RESULT_SMS_TASK)   

8.  pastikan jumlah DATA sesuai dengan final SMS project
poin 8 done

pakai QUERY ini broo

/*`db_sms_smartcoll`*/
SELECT TIME(`created_timestamp`),COUNT(*) 'jumlah'
FROM `sms_result`
GROUP BY TIME(`created_timestamp`)WITH ROLLUP ;
